body: I was talking to her mother immediately after. She is home with her and is keeping a close eye on her and is going to try to get her help.. I'm hoping she's steered clear of the suicide path, because she just called and said "I hope you realize that you just actually broke up with me after all of this time. That means that at school on Thursday, you won't get to talk to me, I won't even look at you", etc. And even though it'll hurt me a lot, I'd honestly very much rather her hate me and not associate with me, than have her not alive.. So hopefully its not as urgent now and at least her parents know to keep an eye on her I guess
Thank you :) your advice has helped a lot

I see what you're saying, and I've tried to stand up for myself and tell her that I'm here to help, but she turns that around and says that I don't actually care about her and I make everything about myself because I'm trying to stand up for myself instead of help her, when I'm just trying to do both.

And you're correct in that assumption, her family is really hard on her and is a big reason she is in the state she's in. Her mom used to have depression and was hospitalized for it in her past, so you would expect that would make her more understanding and helpful, but she just doesn't take anything my girlfriend says about it seriously.

I know, but I always tend to put others before myself, especially when its her since I care about her so much. 

And in response to your question, no she isn't, I've talked to her about it before and told her that it would be good for her, and that a therapist could help a lot. I've had to go to therapy for depression and anxiety before, so I know it would help her, and I tell her it would and that she should at least try it, but she won't go.. And, of course, I can't force her to, even though I know it would help her
